title: Navigatio
author: P. James Garrett
description:
You have lived your life in cells...

You were a hostage, sold to your king by parents of whom you have no memories. Then, you became a slave to a corrupt and depraved landlord. You try to avoid those memories, though they refuse to leave you.

Brother Tuan saved you. Now, at nearly 20 years, you serve him and live in a corbelled stone beehive cell in an Irish monastery near the sea. The transitions from one life to another, one cell to the other, do not matter.

Two things matter.

First, Tuan treats you well--so well that the other monks regard you as one of their own.

Second, you would follow Tuan anywhere.
